_about: Measured cost/memory coefficients for nvalchemi-toolkit + FairChem UMA, used by plan_run.py. Every number is from a real run; see benchmark/uma_efficiency/README.md for the derivations. Recalibrate by re-running the efficiency matrix (run_efficiency_matrix.sh) and refitting (README.md, 'Recalibrating').

reference.system: Au-Pt fcc, a = 4.00 A, 500 atoms (5x5x5 conventional cells), 1200 K
reference.measured: 2026-09-24..28, efficiency matrix (run_efficiency_matrix.sh, one allocation per kernel), 20-100 blocks

time_model._form: one batched step takes c1_ms_per_atom * (n0_atoms + width * n_atoms_eff) ms on the reference GPU; n0 is the fixed per-call overhead in atom-equivalents. Fitted through measured width-1 and width-4 medians; reproduces width 2 within 1-3%.

memory_model._form: peak reserved GiB = base_gib + width * per_walker_gib, per_walker scaled linearly with n_atoms_eff / 500. Straight line through measured width-1 and width-4 peaks (conservative at width 2 where the growth is super-linear).

size_scaling._note: Per-walker memory measured 5.6 MB/atom at 500 atoms but 7.9-8.0 MB/atom at 1372-2048 atoms for full-force compiled runs (memory_profile_matrix.py); checkpointed runs stay linear (4.28 MB/atom). Applied as a conservative ramp to non-checkpointed memory, and to compiled per-atom time, which showed the same ~1.4x at 1372-2048 atoms.
